_comment: Prismatic collection. Each name in 'lines' brings in its WHOLE evolutionary line. The 18 lines were picked with `generate.py pick --count 18 --seed prismatic-spectrum` (since #24 collections may share lines; picks take never-used lines first), then given a look each (three lines per look). Shared look in styles/_prism.py.

readme.title: Prismatic
readme.summary: Pokemon that split light into every colour.
looks: each line wears one look: holographic silver foil (Rattata, Bidoof, Pikipek); the full spectrum from feet to head (Ekans, Poliwag, Basculin); a cut crystal with rainbow facets (Sableye, Sandshrew, Crabrawler); milky opal with flashes of colour (Shuppet, Mimikyu, Lillipup); a dark oil-slick sheen (Nymble, Carnivine, Arctozolt); white glass crossed by beams of refracted light (Sudowoodo, Chespin, Mudbray)
the colours shift round the wheel and glow in the dark; rainbow eyes
shiny: black opal, a darker body that makes the colours blaze
